We store your nickname and stamp history, together with your grade, class and attendance number for students, or participant ID for guests. Only administrators can view progress and rankings. We do not collect real names, contact details or location data, or upload camera footage or images. The cookie and visible stamp history last 30 days. Organizers delete server records after the festival. Use the same device and browser. If you delete cookies or change devices, sign in with your nickname and recovery code. If you lose the code, issue a new one on the original device or contact reception.

全部集めて特典と交換: Collect them all for your reward
「特典」タブに残りの個数が出ます。コンプリートしたら「報酬を受け取る」を押し、係: The Rewards tab shows how many stamps are left. Once you complete the rally, press Claim your reward and show the screen to a staff member.
四角い枠の真ん中にQRコード全体が入るよう、端末を少し離して構えてください。近づ: Hold your phone back a little so the whole QR code sits in the middle of the square frame. Too close and the camera cannot focus.
暗いところでは読み取れないことがあります。窓際や照明の下など、QRコードに光が当: A dark corner can stop the code being read. Try a window or a light so the QR code is lit.
歩きながらでは像がぶれて読み取れません。立ち止まって端末を止めると、すぐに読み取: A moving phone blurs the picture. Stand still and hold it steady, and it reads straight away.
QRコードがうまく読み取れません: The QR code will not scan
端末を少し離して、枠の中央にQRコード全体が入るようにしてください。暗い場所では: Hold your phone back so the whole code sits in the middle of the frame. In a dark spot the camera struggles to focus, so try turning towards the light. If it still will not read, use Choose a photo of a QR code on the scan screen to read it from a picture.
ブラウザのカメラ権限が許可されているかご確認ください（端末の設定 → ブラウザ: Check that your browser is allowed to use the camera (device settings -> browser -> camera). Some connections cannot show a live camera at all; there the scan screen switches by itself to reading a photo you take.
同じスタンプを何度でも取れますか: Can I collect the same stamp twice?
1か所につき1個までです。獲得済みのQRコードを読み取ったときは、その場でお知ら: One stamp per location. Scanning a code you already have tells you so on the spot, and your total stays the same.
登録やログインは必要ですか: Do I need to register or sign in?
最初にニックネームなどを登録すると、参加情報をこの端末のブラウザに保存します。パ: You register once with a nickname and a few details, and your pass is kept in this browser. There is no password. We do not collect your name, contact details or location, and no camera footage is sent.
端末を変えたい・Cookieを消してしまいました: I want to switch phones, or I cleared my cookies
設定の「再ログイン・端末の変更」で復旧コードを発行しておくと、ニックネームと復旧: Issue a recovery code under Moving to another phone in settings, and your nickname plus that code brings the same stamp book back. If you lose the code, issue a new one on the original phone or ask at the reception desk.
混み具合はどうやって決まりますか: How is the crowd level worked out?
直近のQRコード読み取り件数と、参加者からの報告の平均で表示します。報告がある場: From the number of recent scans and the average of what participants report. Where there are reports, the reports win. It is a rough guide, not an exact waiting time.
特典はどうやって受け取りますか: How do I claim the reward?
全てのスタンプを集めると「特典」タブに「報酬を受け取る」が出ます。押すと係員用の: Collect every stamp and Claim your reward appears on the Rewards tab. Pressing it opens a screen for staff, and the hand-over is final once a staff member enters their PIN. A reward can only be claimed once.
ドラッグで移動、矢印キーでも動かせます: Drag to move, or use the arrow keys
枠はドラッグで移動、右下の角で大きさを変えられます。選んでから矢印キーでも動かせ: Drag an area to move it, or its bottom-right corner to resize. Once selected, the arrow keys move it too (Shift resizes, Alt takes bigger steps).
